overview: Loud, proud and absurdly strong, Brakka wants a mate who can keep up with her clan's traditions, and who sees the soft heart under all that muscle. Might impresses her; kind words decide which future she picks.
tips: Her favourite gift is a Great Battle Axe; she also likes Raw Wyvern Steak, a Keg of Dwarven Ale, a Bottle of Rum and a Horn of Honey Mead. Avoid the Imported Tea Set and Exotic Perfume.
Her favourite date is a Picnic in Whisperwood. Find her at the Arena & Training Grounds by day and the Tipsy Wyvern in the evening.
Train Might: her checks are Might 2, 3, 3 and 4, and Romance Scenes II and III need Might 2 and 3 to unlock. Warchief needs Might 4.

endings.title: Warrior's Bond
endings.summary: A proper Ironjaw wedding: shouting, an axe ceremony, a three-day feast and a ritual headbutt. You earn her father's blessing by losing an arm-wrestle bravely, live in the ever-growing hut in the hills, and cheer from the stands while she keeps winning. The classic warrior romance: she stays a champion.
howTo: The default ending: you get it whenever neither variant's conditions are met.
To avoid Warchief: don't combine carrying her in Romance Scene III with winning the lift (Romance Scene I) or the courting fight (Romance Scene II).
To avoid Gentlest Orc: don't choose both "You're not too much, Brakka. You're exactly enough." (Romance Scene I) and "Only if I get to court you back." (Romance Scene II).

endings.title: Warchief of the Ironjaw
endings.summary: Her father climbs the hill with twenty war-painted orcs and lays his axe at her feet. Brakka goes home invited, not exiled, becomes Warchief, and outlaws calling anyone "too much." You are her mate, her war-counsel and the only one allowed to tell her no. Her triumphant ending: the exile reclaims her clan.
howTo: In Romance Scene III, choose "Pick her up. (Yes, all of her.)" and pass the Might 4 check.
Plus any one of: in Romance Scene I, "Try with everything you have." (pass Might 3); or in Romance Scene II, "I accept your challenge, Brakka Ironjaw." (pass Might 3).
Chosen automatically at the festival, ahead of her other endings.

endings.title: The Gentlest Orc in the World
endings.summary: Brakka admits she is tired of fighting and wants a garden. She retires from the arena undefeated to an eleven-minute ovation, and you open a cactus nursery together, Brakka's Prickly Friends. Her softest ending: she trades the arena for growing things, and the soft heart turns out to be her strongest part.
howTo: In Romance Scene I, at the feast, choose "You're not too much, Brakka. You're exactly enough."
In Romance Scene II, when she offers the token, choose "Only if I get to court you back."
Chosen automatically at the festival, unless you also met Warchief's conditions, which win. If needed, choose "It's perfect, Brakka." in Romance Scene III.
